Nouvelle offre Gold PROMO : plus de donn: New Gold PROMO offer: more data and calls at no extra cost
Ooredoo Algérie élargit son portefeuille: Ooredoo Algeria is expanding its commercial portfolio by introducing the "Gold PROMO" offer, a temporary promotion allowing customers to benefit from an increased internet volume and additional communications, without any price increase. This initiative is part of the operator's strategy to meet the evolving digital usage of its customer base.
Les trois bacs Gold 2000, Gold 2500 et G: The three Gold tiers—Gold 2000, Gold 2500, and Gold 4000—see their mobile data quotas increase respectively from 70 to 90 GB, 100 to 120 GB, and 200 to 220 GB. This 20 GB increase applies to all three concerned plans, with no price changes. Furthermore, the Gold 2000 tier now includes unlimited calls to all national networks, replacing the former credit of 6,000 dinars.
Avec cette mise à jour, Ooredoo Algérie: With this update, Ooredoo Algeria is targeting its customers' increased connectivity needs, particularly for streaming, online gaming, social media, and digital services requiring a stable and high-performance connection. The operator emphasizes that this offer combines data volume, communication freedom, and pricing stability.
La direction de la communication institu: The corporate communications department specifies that the "Gold PROMO" initiative illustrates the company's ongoing commitment to aligning its services with consumer expectations while maintaining affordable pricing.
